description: Tracking plan for the real-estate demo persona. Events emitted by the browser SDK on the listing portal.

events.name: page
events.description: Automatic page-view call emitted by the RudderStack JS SDK on every navigation.

properties.name: search
properties.description: Query string portion of the URL

events.name: Listing Viewed
events.description: Fired when a visitor opens a listing detail page or hovers on a listing card for ≥3 seconds.

properties.name: listed_days_ago
properties.description: Days since the listing went live

properties.name: view_count
properties.description: Total views this listing has received

properties.name: amenities
properties.description: Array of amenity strings, e.g. pool, garage

events.name: Filter Applied
events.description: Fired when the visitor submits a search filter on the listings index page.

properties.name: filter_type
properties.description: Category of filter: search | map | sort

properties.name: suburb
properties.description: Suburb slug selected in the filter

properties.name: results_count
properties.description: Number of listings returned by the filter
